policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Employees are entitled to 18 paid annual leave days per calendar year.
policies.rule: 18 paid days per calendar year.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Annual leave must be requested through the HR portal using the Annual Leave Request Form.
policies.rule: Submit through the HR portal.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Notice
policies.text: Employees should normally submit annual leave requests at least 3 working days before the intended leave date.
policies.rule: 3 working days' advance notice.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Half-day Leave
policies.text: Annual leave may be taken in half-day increments.
policies.rule: Minimum increment: 0.5 day.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Carry Forward
policies.text: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the following calendar year. Carry-forward days expire after the following calendar year.
policies.rule: Maximum carry-forward: 5 days.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Encashment
policies.text: Eligible unused annual leave may be encashed at separation, subject to company policy and applicable rules.
policies.rule: Eligibility is determined during separation processing.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Approval
policies.text: A manager may decline or request a different leave date when there is a genuine operational requirement.
policies.rule: Manager approval is required.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Separation
policies.text: Eligible unused annual leave is handled during separation according to the leave encashment policy.
policies.rule: Final treatment is determined during separation processing.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year.
policies.rule: 10 paid days per calendar year.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Sick leave should be recorded through the HR portal as soon as reasonably possible.
policies.rule: Notify the company and record the absence in the HR portal.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Medical Certificate
policies.text: A medical certificate is required when sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive working days.
policies.rule: Medical certificate required after 2 consecutive working days.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Unexpected Illness
policies.text: If an employee becomes suddenly ill and cannot apply beforehand, they should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible and record the sick leave when able.
policies.rule: Prompt notification is required where practical.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Half-day Leave
policies.text: Sick leave may be taken in half-day increments.
policies.rule: Minimum increment: 0.5 day.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Carry Forward
policies.text: Unused sick leave does not carry forward to the next calendar year.
policies.rule: No carry-forward.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Unpaid leave may be requested when paid leave has been exhausted or for a genuine personal reason, subject to approval.
policies.rule: Paid leave should generally be exhausted first, unless HR approves otherwise.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Employees must submit an Unpaid Leave Request Form through the HR portal and obtain the required manager and HR approvals.
policies.rule: Manager and HR approval required.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Approval
policies.text: Approval depends on the reason, operational impact, available paid leave, and manager and HR review.
policies.rule: Approval is case-by-case.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Salary Impact
policies.text: Salary is reduced in proportion to approved unpaid leave days.
policies.rule: Unpaid days are unpaid and reduce salary accordingly.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Eligible employees may receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
policies.rule: 16 weeks paid parental leave.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Employees who have completed 6 months of continuous employment are eligible following birth, adoption, or placement of a child.
policies.rule: Minimum service: 6 continuous months.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Notice
policies.text: Employees should normally submit parental leave requests 30 days in advance where reasonably possible.
policies.rule: 30 days' advance notice where reasonably possible.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Documentation
policies.text: HR may request reasonable supporting documentation relating to birth, adoption, or placement.
policies.rule: Supporting documentation may be required.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Splitting Leave
policies.text: Parental leave may be taken continuously or in up to two blocks, subject to HR approval.
policies.rule: Maximum: two blocks.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Paid Status
policies.text: Eligible parental leave is paid for up to 16 weeks under company policy.
policies.rule: Paid for up to 16 weeks.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Combining Leave
policies.text: Different leave types may be combined where each leave type's eligibility and approval requirements are met.
policies.rule: Each leave type must independently satisfy its requirements.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Unauthorized Absence
policies.text: Unapproved absence may be treated as unauthorized absence and may affect attendance records and pay, subject to company procedures.
policies.rule: Approval should be obtained before leave except in genuine emergencies.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Leave Balance
policies.text: Employees can view their current leave balance in the HR portal.
policies.rule: Check the HR portal for the current balance.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Support
policies.text: Employees should contact their reporting manager for approval questions and HR Operations for policy or system questions.
policies.rule: Manager: approval. HR: policy/system support.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Urgent Leave
policies.text: For urgent leave, employees should notify their reporting manager as soon as possible and submit the appropriate leave request through the HR portal when practical.
policies.rule: Prompt manager notification is expected.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Employees may receive up to 5 paid working days of bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member.
policies.rule: Up to 5 paid working days.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Bereavement leave applies to the death of an immediate family member, including a spouse, parent, child, sibling, or legal guardian.
policies.rule: Immediate-family relationship must apply.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Employees should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible and submit the Bereavement Leave Form when practical.
policies.rule: Prompt notification; documentation may be requested.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Eligible birthing employees may take up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.
policies.rule: 26 weeks paid maternity leave.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Start Date
policies.text: Maternity leave may begin up to 8 weeks before the expected date of delivery.
policies.rule: May start up to 8 weeks before expected delivery.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Notice and Documentation
policies.text: Employees should notify HR at least 8 weeks before the planned start date and provide a medical certificate confirming the expected delivery date.
policies.rule: 8 weeks' notice plus medical certificate.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Return to Work
policies.text: Employees returning from maternity leave are entitled to return to the same or an equivalent role and may request flexible working for up to 6 months after return.
policies.rule: Same/equivalent role; flexible working up to 6 months.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Nursing Breaks
policies.text: Employees returning from maternity leave are entitled to two paid 30-minute nursing breaks per working day until the child is 15 months old.
policies.rule: Two paid 30-minute breaks daily until child is 15 months.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Eligible non-birthing parents, including fathers and partners, may take up to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave.
policies.rule: 2 weeks paid paternity leave.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Timing
policies.text: Paternity leave must be taken within 6 months of the child's birth or placement, continuously or in two separate weeks.
policies.rule: Within 6 months; up to two blocks.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Notice
policies.text: Employees should give at least 4 weeks' notice of paternity leave where reasonably possible.
policies.rule: 4 weeks' notice where possible.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Prenatal Appointments
policies.text: Pregnant employees are entitled to paid time off to attend prenatal medical appointments, and partners may take paid time off to attend up to 2 such appointments.
policies.rule: Paid prenatal appointments; partners up to 2.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Pregnancy-Related Illness
policies.text: Absence due to pregnancy-related illness is recorded separately from regular sick leave and does not reduce the sick leave balance.
policies.rule: Separate from sick leave balance.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Pregnancy Loss
policies.text: Employees who experience miscarriage or stillbirth, and their partners, may take up to 2 weeks of paid leave.
policies.rule: Up to 2 weeks paid leave.

policies.name: Adoption Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: The primary adopter may take up to 16 weeks of paid adoption leave from the date of placement; the secondary adopter is eligible for paternity leave.
policies.rule: Primary adopter 16 weeks paid; secondary adopter uses paternity leave.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: Employee Leave Approval
policies.text: For employees, annual, sick, unpaid and bereavement leave is approved by the Reporting Manager. Leave longer than 10 consecutive working days also requires HR Operations sign-off.
policies.rule: For employees, annual, sick, unpaid and bereavement leave is approved by the Reporting Manager.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: Intern Leave Approval
policies.text: For interns, all leave is approved by the assigned Intern Mentor or Reporting Manager, and HR Operations is notified. Interns accrue 1 paid leave day per completed month of internship and are not eligible for parental, maternity or adoption pay unless their contract states otherwise; unpaid leave may be granted.
policies.rule: For interns, all leave is approved by the assigned Intern Mentor or Reporting Manager, and HR Operations is notified.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: HR Staff Leave Approval
policies.text: For HR team members, leave is approved by the Head of HR. The Head of HR's own leave is approved by the CEO.
policies.rule: For HR team members, leave is approved by the Head of HR.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: CEO Leave Approval
policies.text: The CEO's leave is notified to the Board Chair and recorded by HR Operations; no manager approval is required.
policies.rule: The CEO's leave is notified to the Board Chair and recorded by HR Operations; no manager approval is required.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: Family Leave Approval
policies.text: Maternity, paternity, adoption and parental leave are approved by HR Operations after the Reporting Manager is informed. Managers cannot refuse statutory or policy family leave entitlements, but may discuss timing for paternity blocks.
policies.rule: Maternity, paternity, adoption and parental leave are approved by HR Operations after the Reporting Manager is informed.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: Approval Timelines
policies.text: Managers should respond to leave requests within 3 working days. If no response is received, the request escalates automatically to the manager's manager, then to HR Operations.
policies.rule: Managers should respond to leave requests within 3 working days.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: Rejected Requests
policies.text: If leave is refused, the approver must give a reason in writing. Employees may appeal to HR Operations within 5 working days.
policies.rule: If leave is refused, the approver must give a reason in writing.

policies.name: Leave Approval Matrix
policies.title: Emergency Leave
policies.text: In an emergency, employees should inform their Reporting Manager as soon as possible, by phone if needed, and submit the leave request within 2 working days of returning.
policies.rule: In an emergency, employees should inform their Reporting Manager as soon as possible, by phone if needed, and submit the leave request within 2 working days of returning.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: Employee Access
policies.text: Employees can view and update their own personal details, leave balance, payslips and documents. Employees cannot see other employees' personal data, salaries or leave reasons; they may see colleagues' names, job titles, team and work contact details in the company directory.
policies.rule: Employees can view and update their own personal details, leave balance, payslips and documents.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: Intern Access
policies.text: Interns can view their own profile, leave balance, stipend statements and internship documents. Interns have directory-only access to colleagues and no access to any other personal or employment data.
policies.rule: Interns can view their own profile, leave balance, stipend statements and internship documents.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: Manager Access
policies.text: Reporting Managers can see their direct reports' leave balances, leave calendar, attendance and performance records. Managers cannot see medical details, bank details or salary data unless separately authorised by HR.
policies.rule: Reporting Managers can see their direct reports' leave balances, leave calendar, attendance and performance records.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: HR Access
policies.text: HR staff can access employee records, contracts, compensation, leave records and supporting documents strictly as needed for their duties. Medical documents and grievance files are restricted to named HR case owners. All HR access is logged and audited quarterly.
policies.rule: HR staff can access employee records, contracts, compensation, leave records and supporting documents strictly as needed for their duties.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: CEO Access
policies.text: The CEO can view organisation-wide reports, headcount, aggregated compensation and leave statistics. Access to an individual's sensitive records (medical, grievance, disciplinary) requires a documented business reason and is provided through the Head of HR.
policies.rule: The CEO can view organisation-wide reports, headcount, aggregated compensation and leave statistics.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: Payroll Access
policies.text: Payroll / HR Operations can access salary, bank and tax details solely to process pay. These details are not shared with managers or colleagues.
policies.rule: Payroll / HR Operations can access salary, bank and tax details solely to process pay.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: Your Data Rights
policies.text: Any employee or intern may request a copy of the personal data held about them, or correction of inaccurate data, using the Data Access Request Form. HR will respond within 30 days.
policies.rule: Any employee or intern may request a copy of the personal data held about them, or correction of inaccurate data, using the Data Access Request Form.

policies.name: Employee Data Access
policies.title: Data Retention
policies.text: Leave and employment records are kept for 6 years after employment ends; medical documents for leave are kept for 2 years and then securely deleted.
policies.rule: Leave and employment records are kept for 6 years after employment ends; medical documents for leave are kept for 2 years and then securely deleted.

policies.name: Role Responsibilities
policies.title: Employees
policies.text: Employees are responsible for requesting leave in advance, keeping personal details up to date, and following company policies.
policies.rule: Employees are responsible for requesting leave in advance, keeping personal details up to date, and following company policies.

policies.name: Role Responsibilities
policies.title: Interns
policies.text: Interns follow the same conduct and leave request rules as employees, report to an assigned mentor, and should raise questions with HR Operations or their mentor.
policies.rule: Interns follow the same conduct and leave request rules as employees, report to an assigned mentor, and should raise questions with HR Operations or their mentor.

policies.name: Role Responsibilities
policies.title: HR Team
policies.text: The HR team administers leave, maintains employee records, advises managers and employees on policy, manages grievances confidentially and approves family leave.
policies.rule: The HR team administers leave, maintains employee records, advises managers and employees on policy, manages grievances confidentially and approves family leave.

policies.name: Role Responsibilities
policies.title: CEO
policies.text: The CEO approves company-wide policy changes, final appeals on disciplinary matters, and exceptions to leave policy above 20 working days. The CEO does not approve routine leave for individual employees.
policies.rule: The CEO approves company-wide policy changes, final appeals on disciplinary matters, and exceptions to leave policy above 20 working days.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Accrual
policies.text: Annual leave accrues monthly at 1.5 days per month. New joiners receive a pro-rated entitlement in their first year.
policies.rule: Annual leave accrues monthly at 1.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Carry Forward
policies.text: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried into the next calendar year and must be used by 31 March, after which they lapse.
policies.rule: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried into the next calendar year and must be used by 31 March, after which they lapse.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Advance Notice
policies.text: Requests of 1-2 days need 3 working days' notice; 3 or more days need 2 weeks' notice.
policies.rule: Requests of 1-2 days need 3 working days' notice; 3 or more days need 2 weeks' notice.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Encashment
policies.text: Unused annual leave is paid out only on leaving the company, for the current year's accrued but untaken days.
policies.rule: Unused annual leave is paid out only on leaving the company, for the current year's accrued but untaken days.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Public Holidays
policies.text: Public holidays falling during annual leave are not deducted from the annual leave balance.
policies.rule: Public holidays falling during annual leave are not deducted from the annual leave balance.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Part-Time Staff
policies.text: Part-time employees receive annual leave pro-rated to their contracted hours.
policies.rule: Part-time employees receive annual leave pro-rated to their contracted hours.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Half Days
policies.text: Annual leave may be taken in half-day units.
policies.rule: Annual leave may be taken in half-day units.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year. Interns receive 5 paid sick days per internship year.
policies.rule: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Reporting Sickness
policies.text: Inform your Reporting Manager before your normal start time on the first day of absence.
policies.rule: Inform your Reporting Manager before your normal start time on the first day of absence.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Medical Certificate
policies.text: A medical certificate is required for absences of more than 2 consecutive working days.
policies.rule: A medical certificate is required for absences of more than 2 consecutive working days.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Long-Term Sickness
policies.text: After 10 paid sick days are used, further sickness absence may be unpaid; HR will discuss options including unpaid leave or annual leave.
policies.rule: After 10 paid sick days are used, further sickness absence may be unpaid; HR will discuss options including unpaid leave or annual leave.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Family Sickness
policies.text: Up to 3 of the paid sick days per year may be used to care for a sick dependent child or family member.
policies.rule: Up to 3 of the paid sick days per year may be used to care for a sick dependent child or family member.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Carry Forward
policies.text: Unused sick days do not carry forward and are not paid out.
policies.rule: Unused sick days do not carry forward and are not paid out.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Immediate Family
policies.text: Up to 5 paid days for the death of a spouse/partner, child, parent or sibling.
policies.rule: Up to 5 paid days for the death of a spouse/partner, child, parent or sibling.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Extended Family
policies.text: Up to 2 paid days for the death of a grandparent, grandchild, in-law, aunt or uncle.
policies.rule: Up to 2 paid days for the death of a grandparent, grandchild, in-law, aunt or uncle.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Travel
policies.text: An additional 2 paid days may be granted if travel abroad is required, with Reporting Manager approval.
policies.rule: An additional 2 paid days may be granted if travel abroad is required, with Reporting Manager approval.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Employees with at least 6 months' service may request up to 30 days of unpaid leave per year after annual leave is used.
policies.rule: Employees with at least 6 months' service may request up to 30 days of unpaid leave per year after annual leave is used.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Approval
policies.text: Unpaid leave requires Reporting Manager and HR Operations approval. Longer than 30 days requires CEO approval.
policies.rule: Unpaid leave requires Reporting Manager and HR Operations approval.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Effect on Benefits
policies.text: Annual leave does not accrue during unpaid leave of more than 10 days.
policies.rule: Annual leave does not accrue during unpaid leave of more than 10 days.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Maternity leave is available to employees with at least 80 days of service in the 12 months before the expected delivery date.
policies.rule: Maternity leave is available to employees with at least 80 days of service in the 12 months before the expected delivery date.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Pay
policies.text: Maternity leave is paid at full salary for 26 weeks. A further up to 4 weeks of unpaid leave may be requested.
policies.rule: Maternity leave is paid at full salary for 26 weeks.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Third Child Onward
policies.text: For a third or subsequent child, paid maternity leave is 12 weeks.
policies.rule: For a third or subsequent child, paid maternity leave is 12 weeks.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Keeping-in-Touch Days
policies.text: Employees may work up to 10 optional paid keeping-in-touch days during maternity leave without ending the leave.
policies.rule: Employees may work up to 10 optional paid keeping-in-touch days during maternity leave without ending the leave.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Benefits During Leave
policies.text: Annual leave continues to accrue and health benefits continue during maternity leave.
policies.rule: Annual leave continues to accrue and health benefits continue during maternity leave.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Work From Home
policies.text: After maternity leave, employees may request work from home arrangements, subject to role requirements and manager approval.
policies.rule: After maternity leave, employees may request work from home arrangements, subject to role requirements and manager approval.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Protection
policies.text: No employee may be dismissed or disadvantaged because of pregnancy or maternity leave.
policies.rule: No employee may be dismissed or disadvantaged because of pregnancy or maternity leave.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Paternity leave is available to employees with at least 6 months' service, including same-sex partners and the partner of a surrogate mother.
policies.rule: Paternity leave is available to employees with at least 6 months' service, including same-sex partners and the partner of a surrogate mother.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Pay
policies.text: Paternity leave is paid at full salary.
policies.rule: Paternity leave is paid at full salary.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Interns
policies.text: Interns may take up to 5 days of unpaid paternity leave.
policies.rule: Interns may take up to 5 days of unpaid paternity leave.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Workplace Adjustments
policies.text: Pregnant employees may request adjustments such as flexible hours, seating or remote work; HR will complete a risk assessment.
policies.rule: Pregnant employees may request adjustments such as flexible hours, seating or remote work; HR will complete a risk assessment.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Fertility Treatment
policies.text: Employees may take up to 5 paid days per year for fertility treatment (e.g. IVF) appointments.
policies.rule: Employees may take up to 5 paid days per year for fertility treatment (e.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Medical Termination
policies.text: Employees may take up to 6 weeks of paid leave following a medical termination of pregnancy, with a medical certificate.
policies.rule: Employees may take up to 6 weeks of paid leave following a medical termination of pregnancy, with a medical certificate.

policies.name: Adoption Leave
policies.title: Child Age
policies.text: Adoption leave applies to adoption of a child under 18; the 16 weeks starts from placement.
policies.rule: Adoption leave applies to adoption of a child under 18; the 16 weeks starts from placement.

policies.name: Adoption Leave
policies.title: Surrogacy
policies.text: Commissioning parents through surrogacy are eligible for adoption leave on the same terms.
policies.rule: Commissioning parents through surrogacy are eligible for adoption leave on the same terms.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Marriage Leave
policies.text: Employees receive 3 paid days for their own marriage, to be taken within 3 months of the wedding.
policies.rule: Employees receive 3 paid days for their own marriage, to be taken within 3 months of the wedding.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Compensatory Off
policies.text: Employees who work on a weekend or public holiday at a manager's request may take a compensatory day off within 60 days.
policies.rule: Employees who work on a weekend or public holiday at a manager's request may take a compensatory day off within 60 days.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Jury and Civic Duty
policies.text: Paid leave is provided for jury service or required court attendance as a witness.
policies.rule: Paid leave is provided for jury service or required court attendance as a witness.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Volunteering
policies.text: Employees receive 2 paid volunteering days per year for registered charities.
policies.rule: Employees receive 2 paid volunteering days per year for registered charities.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Study Leave
policies.text: Employees may take up to 5 paid days per year for exams related to approved courses.
policies.rule: Employees may take up to 5 paid days per year for exams related to approved courses.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Sabbatical
policies.text: Employees with 5 years' service may request an unpaid sabbatical of up to 3 months, subject to CEO approval.
policies.rule: Employees with 5 years' service may request an unpaid sabbatical of up to 3 months, subject to CEO approval.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Menstrual Health
policies.text: Employees may take up to 1 paid day per month for menstrual health, recorded separately from sick leave.
policies.rule: Employees may take up to 1 paid day per month for menstrual health, recorded separately from sick leave.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Caregiver Leave
policies.text: Employees may take up to 5 unpaid days per year to care for a dependent with a long-term illness or disability.
policies.rule: Employees may take up to 5 unpaid days per year to care for a dependent with a long-term illness or disability.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Domestic Violence
policies.text: Employees affected by domestic violence may take up to 10 paid days of confidential leave; contact HR Helpdesk in confidence.
policies.rule: Employees affected by domestic violence may take up to 10 paid days of confidential leave; contact HR Helpdesk in confidence.

policies.name: Other Leave
policies.title: Religious Holidays
policies.text: Employees may swap a public holiday for a religious holiday of their choice with manager approval.
policies.rule: Employees may swap a public holiday for a religious holiday of their choice with manager approval.

faqs.q: How much maternity leave do I get?
faqs.a: Eligible birthing employees may take up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.

faqs.q: When can I start my pregnancy leave before delivery?
faqs.a: Maternity leave may begin up to 8 weeks before the expected date of delivery.

faqs.q: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get?
faqs.a: Eligible non-birthing parents may take up to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave.

faqs.q: Can I take time off for prenatal or pregnancy checkups?
faqs.a: Pregnant employees get paid time off for prenatal appointments; partners may attend up to 2.

faqs.q: Does pregnancy sickness count against my sick leave?
faqs.a: No. Pregnancy-related illness is recorded separately from sick leave.

faqs.q: Is there leave after a miscarriage?
faqs.a: Employees and partners may take up to 2 weeks of paid leave after miscarriage or stillbirth.

faqs.q: Do I get breastfeeding or nursing breaks after returning?
faqs.a: Two paid 30-minute nursing breaks per day until the child is 15 months old.

faqs.q: How much adoption leave is there?
faqs.a: The primary adopter may take up to 16 weeks of paid adoption leave.

faqs.q: Who approves my leave as an employee?
faqs.a: For employees, annual, sick, unpaid and bereavement leave is approved by the Reporting Manager. Leave longer than 10 consecutive working days also requires HR Operations sign-off.

faqs.q: Who approves employee leave requests?
faqs.a: For employees, annual, sick, unpaid and bereavement leave is approved by the Reporting Manager. Leave longer than 10 consecutive working days also requires HR Operations sign-off.

faqs.q: Who signs off my holiday?
faqs.a: For employees, annual, sick, unpaid and bereavement leave is approved by the Reporting Manager. Leave longer than 10 consecutive working days also requires HR Operations sign-off.

faqs.q: Who approves my leave as an intern?
faqs.a: For interns, all leave is approved by the assigned Intern Mentor or Reporting Manager, and HR Operations is notified. Interns accrue 1 paid leave day per completed month of internship and are not eligible for parental, maternity or adoption pay unless their contract states otherwise; unpaid leave may be granted.

faqs.q: Who approves intern leave?
faqs.a: For interns, all leave is approved by the assigned Intern Mentor or Reporting Manager, and HR Operations is notified. Interns accrue 1 paid leave day per completed month of internship and are not eligible for parental, maternity or adoption pay unless their contract states otherwise; unpaid leave may be granted.

faqs.q: Can interns get maternity or paternity leave?
faqs.a: For interns, all leave is approved by the assigned Intern Mentor or Reporting Manager, and HR Operations is notified. Interns accrue 1 paid leave day per completed month of internship and are not eligible for parental, maternity or adoption pay unless their contract states otherwise; unpaid leave may be granted.

faqs.q: Who approves leave for HR staff?
faqs.a: For HR team members, leave is approved by the Head of HR. The Head of HR's own leave is approved by the CEO.

faqs.q: Who approves the head of HR's leave?
faqs.a: For HR team members, leave is approved by the Head of HR. The Head of HR's own leave is approved by the CEO.

faqs.q: Who approves the CEO's leave?
faqs.a: The CEO's leave is notified to the Board Chair and recorded by HR Operations; no manager approval is required.

faqs.q: Who approves maternity paternity adoption leave?
faqs.a: Maternity, paternity, adoption and parental leave are approved by HR Operations after the Reporting Manager is informed. Managers cannot refuse statutory or policy family leave entitlements, but may discuss timing for paternity blocks.

faqs.q: Can my manager refuse my maternity leave?
faqs.a: Maternity, paternity, adoption and parental leave are approved by HR Operations after the Reporting Manager is informed. Managers cannot refuse statutory or policy family leave entitlements, but may discuss timing for paternity blocks.

faqs.q: How long does leave approval take?
faqs.a: Managers should respond to leave requests within 3 working days. If no response is received, the request escalates automatically to the manager's manager, then to HR Operations.

faqs.q: My manager has not approved my leave request
faqs.a: Managers should respond to leave requests within 3 working days. If no response is received, the request escalates automatically to the manager's manager, then to HR Operations.

faqs.q: My leave was rejected can I appeal?
faqs.a: If leave is refused, the approver must give a reason in writing. Employees may appeal to HR Operations within 5 working days.

faqs.q: How do I take emergency leave?
faqs.a: In an emergency, employees should inform their Reporting Manager as soon as possible, by phone if needed, and submit the leave request within 2 working days of returning.

faqs.q: Who can see my data as an employee?
faqs.a: Employees can view and update their own personal details, leave balance, payslips and documents. Employees cannot see other employees' personal data, salaries or leave reasons; they may see colleagues' names, job titles, team and work contact details in the company directory.

faqs.q: Can employees see other people's salary?
faqs.a: Employees can view and update their own personal details, leave balance, payslips and documents. Employees cannot see other employees' personal data, salaries or leave reasons; they may see colleagues' names, job titles, team and work contact details in the company directory.

faqs.q: Can colleagues see my leave reason?
faqs.a: Employees can view and update their own personal details, leave balance, payslips and documents. Employees cannot see other employees' personal data, salaries or leave reasons; they may see colleagues' names, job titles, team and work contact details in the company directory.

faqs.q: What data can interns see?
faqs.a: Interns can view their own profile, leave balance, stipend statements and internship documents. Interns have directory-only access to colleagues and no access to any other personal or employment data.

faqs.q: What can my manager see about me?
faqs.a: Reporting Managers can see their direct reports' leave balances, leave calendar, attendance and performance records. Managers cannot see medical details, bank details or salary data unless separately authorised by HR.

faqs.q: Can managers see my medical details or salary?
faqs.a: Reporting Managers can see their direct reports' leave balances, leave calendar, attendance and performance records. Managers cannot see medical details, bank details or salary data unless separately authorised by HR.

faqs.q: What employee data can HR see?
faqs.a: HR staff can access employee records, contracts, compensation, leave records and supporting documents strictly as needed for their duties. Medical documents and grievance files are restricted to named HR case owners. All HR access is logged and audited quarterly.

faqs.q: Who can see my medical documents?
faqs.a: HR staff can access employee records, contracts, compensation, leave records and supporting documents strictly as needed for their duties. Medical documents and grievance files are restricted to named HR case owners. All HR access is logged and audited quarterly.

faqs.q: What employee data can the CEO see?
faqs.a: The CEO can view organisation-wide reports, headcount, aggregated compensation and leave statistics. Access to an individual's sensitive records (medical, grievance, disciplinary) requires a documented business reason and is provided through the Head of HR.

faqs.q: Can the CEO see my personal records?
faqs.a: The CEO can view organisation-wide reports, headcount, aggregated compensation and leave statistics. Access to an individual's sensitive records (medical, grievance, disciplinary) requires a documented business reason and is provided through the Head of HR.

faqs.q: Who can see my salary and bank details?
faqs.a: Payroll / HR Operations can access salary, bank and tax details solely to process pay. These details are not shared with managers or colleagues.

faqs.q: How do I get a copy of my personal data?
faqs.a: Any employee or intern may request a copy of the personal data held about them, or correction of inaccurate data, using the Data Access Request Form. HR will respond within 30 days.

faqs.q: How long are my records kept?
faqs.a: Leave and employment records are kept for 6 years after employment ends; medical documents for leave are kept for 2 years and then securely deleted.

faqs.q: What does the CEO approve?
faqs.a: The CEO approves company-wide policy changes, final appeals on disciplinary matters, and exceptions to leave policy above 20 working days. The CEO does not approve routine leave for individual employees.

faqs.q: What does HR do?
faqs.a: The HR team administers leave, maintains employee records, advises managers and employees on policy, manages grievances confidentially and approves family leave.
